items.title: MI London's Hundred title defence over despite narrow win over Phoenix
items.description: MI London had the lights turned out on their hopes of claiming a fourth straight Hundred title despite beating bottom-placed Birmingham Phoenix in a nip-and-tuck final men's group match.

items.title: Doue silences Madjo-mania as PSG beat Villa to win Super Cup
items.description: Desire Doue scored the winner as champions of Europe Paris Saint-Germain held off Aston Villa to win the UEFA Super Cup.

items.title: Chelsea set Man City deadline to bid for Fernandez
items.description: Chelsea have told Manchester City they have a deadline of 5pm this Friday to make an offer for Enzo Fernandez.

items.title: Rashford does not feature in Leeds friendly win but still part of Man Utd plans
items.description: Joshua Zirkzee and Brenden Aaronson scored as Manchester United and old foes Leeds played out an entertaining 1-1 friendly draw at the spiritual home of Irish sport in Dublin, before the concluding shoot-out was edged 5-4 by Michael Carrick's side.

items.title: Guimaraes makes bow and Lewis-Skelly scores as Arsenal held by Como
items.description: Bruno Guimaraes made his first appearance and Myles Lewis-Skelly scored amid speculation about his future as Arsenal were held to a 1-1 draw by Como before winning 4-3 on penalties.

items.title: Atletico agree deal to sign Spurs captain Romero
items.description: Atletico Madrid have agreed a deal in principle with Tottenham to sign Cristian Romero.

items.title: Doue goal awarded on VAR after tight offside
items.description: Desire Doue's goal is awarded after initially being flagged offside to give PSG the lead in the second half of the Super Cup against Aston Villa.

items.title: Teenager Madgo scores equaliser for Villa
items.description: 17-year-old Brian Madjo equalisers for Aston Villa against PSG in the Uefa Super Cup.

items.title: Guimaraes makes Arsenal debut in draw with Como
items.description: Bruno Guimaraes put in an assured performance as he made his Arsenal debut in a 1-1 friendly draw with Como at Emirates stadium.

items.title: Atletico agree £34.2m deal for Tottenham's Romero
items.description: Cristian Romero is set to join La Liga side Atletico Madrid as they agree a £34.2m fee with Tottenham for their captain.

items.title: Kvaratskhelia smashes PSG into lead in Super Cup
items.description: Khvicha Kvaratskhelia smashes PSG into lead in the Uefa Super Cup against Aston VIlla.

items.title: Jaissle 'aware' of Newcastle needs after Everton friendly loss
items.description: Matthias Jaissle says he is "aware" of Newcastle's shortcomings after a comfortable 3-1 friendly defeat by Everton.
